answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each applicant posts a $20 bond and gets an onyx seal; three random peers re-check one task within 48 hours. A tide of new arrivals cannot hide clones, because audits are unpredictable, and cheaters lose their bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs $20,000 plus 3,000 checks, against about $3,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays $20 once, passes one check, and keeps rewards undiluted, like a zephyr.
